# Brief: internal link shortener

Build a URL shortener service for our support team.

- Users create a short link from a long http(s) URL and may choose a custom alias of 4 to 32 characters.
- Visiting a short link redirects to the original URL in under 50 ms at the 95th percentile.
- Links can optionally expire after a given number of days.
- The service must handle 500 redirects per second and 20 link creations per second.
- Admins can see click counts per link for the last 30 days.
- Admins must authenticate with an API key; redirects are public.
- Deploy with Docker on a single host. Use PostgreSQL for storage.

answers.Q1: 99.5% monthly availability is enough for an internal tool
answers.Q2: Click records are kept 90 days, then deleted; no personal data beyond what the request already carries
answers.Q3: Structured logs plus request count, error rate and p95 latency metrics

## Decisions required
### HTTP API
| Option | Gains | Costs |
|---|---|---|
| REST over JSON | widely understood | chatty for complex queries |
| GraphQL | clients choose fields | query cost control needed |
| gRPC | typed, efficient | less browser-friendly |
Engineer decision: ____ (DECISION REQUIRED)

### Persistent storage
| Option | Gains | Costs |
|---|---|---|
| Relational database | constraints and transactions enforce uniqueness and integrity | schema changes need migrations |
| Document store | flexible schema | weaker cross-record guarantees |
| Key-value store | very simple fast lookups | limited querying |
Engineer decision: ____ (DECISION REQUIRED)

### Analytics / reporting
| Option | Gains | Costs |
|---|---|---|
| Aggregate in the primary database | one datastore | load on the primary at scale |
| Dedicated analytics store | isolates heavy queries | extra system and pipeline |
| Pre-computed rollups | fast reads | more write-side complexity |
Engineer decision: ____ (DECISION REQUIRED)

### Authentication and authorisation
| Option | Gains | Costs |
|---|---|---|
| API keys | minimal machinery | manual issuance and rotation |
| OAuth / OIDC | standard, delegated identity | more moving parts |
| Session cookies | fits browser users | CSRF handling needed |
Engineer decision: ____ (DECISION REQUIRED)
